from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u009/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-1d1ca0c0.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    axis_r = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 3 for v in row))
    axis_c = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(h)))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if r != axis_r and c != axis_c:
                if max(abs(r - axis_r), abs(c - axis_c)) % 2 == 0:
                    out[r][c] = 4
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(program_path), 'exec'))
test=[[0]*12 for _ in range(12)]
for r in range(12): test[r][6]=3
for c in range(12): test[8][c]=3
pred=transform(test)
print(''.join(map(str,pred[0])))
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in pred))
